description: This file contains functions for dispatching inbound replies, including building dispatch bases, recording sessions, and dispatching replies with buffered dispatchers. It manages reply dispatching logic in an auto-reply system.

methods.name: dispatchReplyFromConfigWithSettledDispatcher
methods.description: Runs dispatchReplyFromConfig with a dispatcher that always gets its settled callback.

methods.name: buildInboundReplyDispatchBase
methods.description: Assembles common inbound reply dispatch dependencies for a resolved route.

methods.name: dispatchInboundReplyWithBase
methods.description: Resolves the shared dispatch base and immediately records and dispatches one inbound reply turn.

methods.name: recordInboundSessionAndDispatchReply
methods.description: Records the inbound session first, then dispatches the reply using normalized outbound delivery.
